scope: Three prospectively fixed rotating-order stage runs with preallocated GC callback rows and retained existing clock endpoints. No GC settings, forced collections, algorithm or native-library changes. No devices, GUI/SDK, Run, optimization AB or samplers.
checks: Full original oracle before stage timing; each original stage equality gate retained.
Same saved input and all458 original sources must match before/after.
Preflight and formal rows separate; report all stages and blocks without selecting fastest.
No sum of isolated stages as whole-chain time; no per-stage GIL share or causal overhead claim.
Three cases only; no sample extension, no old CPU-case attribution.
GC records include wall/cpu,generation,phase,tid,collected/uncollectable; overflow or unmatched callbacks fail analysis.
Original method AST differs only in saving start clock and adding endpoint output keys, with all original calls unchanged.
GC overlap is wall interval evidence, not exclusive causal CPU cost or explanation of previous unobserved windows.
